subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

Pompeii was a tragedy / that cost the lives / of millions of people.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **that cost the lives**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The relative pronoun "**that**" should be followed by a restrictive clause that provides essential information about the subject.
 
• However, in this sentence, the clause "**that cost the lives**" is non-restrictive and can be removed without changing the meaning of the sentence.
 
• To make the clause restrictive, we can remove the comma after "**tragedy**" and use "**which**" instead of "**that.**"
 
• This error is a common example of a misplaced modifier, where the relative clause is not placed close enough to the noun it modifies.
 
• The sentence could also be rephrased to avoid using a relative pronoun altogether: "The tragedy of Pompeii cost the lives of millions of people."

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Corrected sentence:** .*Pompeii was a tragedy which cost the lives of millions of people.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "**Pompeii was a tragedy**" is grammatically correct and does not contain an error.
 
• Option 3: "**of millions of people**" is also grammatically correct and does not contain an error.
 
• Option 4: "**No error**" is not the correct answer in this case, as there is an error in the sentence.
